subject: POC acceptance criteria & weekly pulse — Clearline Health trial
summary: Post-call recap establishing success criteria, evaluation plan, owners, timeline for Clearline Health POC; weekly nudges to keep trial on track and confirm data access + test scenarios.
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@clearlinehealth.com>, Kate Lin <kate.lin@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC acceptance criteria & next steps (recap from today's call)

Hi Sam / Kate —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap so we're aligned on the POC scope, success criteria, owners, and timeline. I pulled this together from our call notes — please flag anything I missed.

POC scope (2 weeks):
- Ingest a subset of de-identified clinical notes (up to 10k rows) and run Redwood inference pipelines for: summarization, entity extraction (meds, allergies), and triage suggestions.
- Integrate outputs into a Clearline staging table (S3 -> staging schema).

Success criteria (must pass all to be considered successful):
1) Latency: median end-to-end generation latency <= 450ms for 512 token requests under test workload (bursting allowed to 150ms p50 reduction via batching).
2) Accuracy: extraction F1 >= 0.88 on your holdout sample (we'll evaluate against the 500-record gold set you mentioned).
3) Integration: automated export to staging within 30 minutes of run completion + example UI mock with sample outputs.
4) Cost & throughput: cost per 1k requests below your target of $12 (we'll provide detailed runbook).

Roles & owners:
- Clearline: Sam (POC sponsor / data access owner), Kate (clinical SME / acceptance).
- Redwood: Jonas (AM / overall POC lead), Marissa (sales lead / commercial), Rishi (solutions & infra — data onboarding and perf tuning).

Timeline (target):
- Tue 3/3: Clearline provides de-identified sample and gold label set (500 records) + file layout.
- Wed 3/4: Redwood to confirm ingestion plan and share MOP v1 (attached).
- Thu 3/5: Initial runs on sample data; share perf numbers and artifacts.
- Mon 3/9: Joint evaluation review + decision on next steps (expand POC or pilot).

Immediate asks for your team today:
- Share S3 location or secure transfer method for the sample + gold labels.
- Confirm a point-of-contact for networking/data access (IAM role or VPN info).

Attachments: clearline_poc_mop_v1.pdf (draft method of procedure), sample_health_records_schema.csv (column mapping sample).

If that matches your understanding I'll put the MOP into a shared Drive link and kick off the data ingest as soon as we get access.

Thanks — talk soon.

Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for reliable production LLM serving
From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Lin <kate.lin@clearlinehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC acceptance criteria & next steps (recap from today's call)

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap and the MOP. That aligns with our internal goals. A few quick items from our side: 

- We'll deliver the de-identified sample and the 500-record gold set by end of day Tue 3/3. I can share via our secure SFTP or a limited-access S3 bucket — we'll confirm which by EOD.
- Networking: I will grant an IAM role with read access to the bucket once it's created; we'll send role ARN and details to Rishi.
- Clinical acceptance: Kate will run the gold set review and provide a short annotation guide (expected by Fri 3/6).

One ask for Redwood: can you include a simple JSON schema for the output fields (summary, entities, confidence scores) so our UI team can prototype the ingestion?

We're excited to see the initial runs.

Sam
Head of Data Integrations, Clearline Health
sam.jenkins@clearlinehealth.com | +1 619-555-0871
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC acceptance criteria & next steps (recap from today's call)

Sam — perfect, thanks. Two quick notes: 

1) Rishi — when you get the S3 details please confirm access flow and expected IAM ARN format. We'll provision a short-lived role on our side if needed for cross-account reads.

2) Sam — attached is the minimal output JSON schema you requested (fields: id, summary_text, entities[{type, text, start, end, score}], triage_score, model_version, raw_tokens). We'll paste a sample payload in the Drive link.

I'll schedule the Wed run for 11:00am PT and will share perf logs + a sample of outputs within 90m after the run completes.

Thanks — J.
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Data onboarding checklist & perf knobs for Clearline POC

Looping in notes from the infra run-through: 

- We need the S3 bucket ARN and a test object path (e.g., s3://clearline-poc/samples/2026-03-02.json). Please confirm whether Clearline will grant cross-account read or provide temporary credentials.
- File format: newline-delimited JSON preferred. If you send CSV we'll run a conversion; CSV sample is fine.
- Perf knobs: we'll start with model: open-llm-compact-v2; batch size 32; max_tokens 512. If latency is high we'll reduce batch to 8 and enable prefix KV caching for repeated patient-note prefixes.
- Logging: we will push perf logs to the Drive folder and a short-run dashboard link (temporary).

I'll be on call Mon 3/9 for the joint evaluation.

—Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Kate Lin <kate.lin@clearlinehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Weekly pulse — pre-eval checklist and Monday nudge

Morning all — quick pulse before our 10:30am PT review: 

Status so far: 
- Clearline sample & gold set: RECEIVED (thank you, Sam) — Rishi confirmed read access this morning.
- Ingestion: conversion to ndjson completed and verified.
- Wed run results: initial extraction F1 = 0.85; median latency p50 = 520ms (above target; Rishi is tuning).

Action items before today's meeting (owners in parens):
- Rishi: complete perf tuning (try batch=16, enable kv-cache) and rerun two sample jobs by 12:00 PT.
- Kate: upload annotation guide + any edge-case examples to Drive (Kate).
- Sam: confirm whether the UI mock can consume the sample JSON schema we sent (Sam).
- Marissa: prep brief commercial summary (TCO estimate + potential pilot pricing) for decision conversation.

If we miss the success criteria today we'll still use the evaluation to scope a focused pilot (clear milestones). If there's anything blocking please flag now — otherwise see you at 10:30.

Thanks — Jonas
